purpose: Test whether the already-frozen BRI-to-griz color model can identify the five validation anchors directly in signed griz flux space while profiling out brightness, so low-SNR and negative measurements can remain probabilistic evidence rather than being discarded.

likelihood.color_model: Use the unchanged V19AV development coefficients and predictive scales.
likelihood.template: Set relative r-band flux to one; convert predicted colors into positive griz flux ratios on the common AB scale.
likelihood.color_uncertainty_integration: Independent Gaussian predictive colors integrated with tensor-product Gauss-Hermite quadrature.
likelihood.brightness_nuisance: For every color template, profile one nonnegative flux amplitude by weighted least squares.
likelihood.score: log of the Gaussian-color average of exp(-chi2_profile/2); Gaussian flux normalization is omitted so low-information flux cannot become positive identity evidence solely because its uncertainty is large.
likelihood.signed_flux_rule: Every finite positive, zero, or negative griz stack enters with its frozen uncertainty. No SNR or magnitude cut is applied.
likelihood.candidate_application_if_validated: Use only as a relative conditional-candidate likelihood and preserve the pre-existing positional null probability exactly.

validation_gates.failure_rule: Fail closed without changing quadrature order, profiling rule, predictive scales, validation members, top-one gate or reciprocal-rank gate.

claim_boundary: V19AY validates a measurement likelihood; it does not score an ambiguous candidate or change a positional association.
The five anchors are the unchanged internal validation set and are not a newly untouched holdout.
Profiling brightness deliberately removes aperture normalization, so this test can validate color-shape discrimination but cannot estimate stellar luminosity or mass.
A pass authorizes a separately frozen full-posterior application that preserves null and ambiguous states; it does not authorize a hard counterpart, mass, current, lensing, halo or gravity claim.
